title: Ajeeb Dastan Hai Yeh
author: Shailendra
credits: Lyrics Shailendra, music Shankar-Jaikishan, sung by Lata Mangeshkar, from the film Dil Apna Aur Preet Parai (1960)
who: Shailendra was a Hindi film lyricist closely associated with the composer duo Shankar-Jaikishan. Lata Mangeshkar (1929 to 2022) sang for generations of Hindi film heroines. The song is from Dil Apna Aur Preet Parai, released in 1960.
why: The song serves a moment in the film's love story. I do not have a documented account of how it came to be written beyond the film's needs, so I will not add one.
notice: The title already tells you the mood: this is a story that does not quite resolve. Listen for how the voice carries that feeling. Notice how a few simple words about a story can say something larger about love.
prompts: What is a story in your life that you still cannot tell with a neat ending?
Which song do you reach for when you do not know what you feel, and why that one?
